description: Canonical role-to-skill routing rules for AI-Engineer.

company_director.reason: Scope and risk must be explicit before a company project is formed.

requirements.reason: Requirements work needs traceable scope, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.

project_manager.reason: Project planning must preserve scope, risks, and delivery traceability.

ux_designer.reason: UX work is governed by the design-system and interaction contracts.

architect.reason: Architecture decisions must remain traceable to validated requirements.
Service and backend boundaries require backend architecture evidence.
Architectural interfaces need explicit integration contracts.
User-facing architecture requires frontend boundary decisions.
Persistent data work requires an explicit data architecture review.

backend.reason: Backend implementation must follow service, validation, and error-boundary standards.
Database changes require schema, migration, and transaction guidance.
API-facing backend work needs a shared contract and integration checks.
Authentication and authorization changes require the dedicated access-control playbook.

frontend.reason: Frontend changes must implement the approved interaction and design contracts.
Frontend implementation needs explicit routing, state, and component boundaries.
Frontend/backend boundaries require typed integration evidence when an API is involved.

implementer.reason: Generic implementation tasks touching services need backend boundaries.
Generic implementation tasks touching UI need frontend boundaries.
Generic implementation tasks changing persistence need migration guidance.
Generic implementation tasks crossing boundaries need contract evidence.

integration.reason: Integration work verifies contracts across independently changing components.

security.reason: Identity and access changes need the authentication authorization contract.
Security review requires threat modeling and defensive application checks.

tester.reason: Test planning and execution require the testing playbook.
Independent QA requires reproducible defect and regression handling.

debugger.reason: Debugging must capture reproduction, root cause, and a bounded repair.
Repairs require regression protection and verification.

devops.reason: Operational changes must follow deployment, health, and rollback controls.

reviewer.reason: Reviews must inspect test evidence rather than trust status labels.
Independent release review needs a complete cross-layer checklist.
Security-sensitive diffs require an application-security review.

release_verifier.reason: Release readiness requires independent evidence across requirements and quality gates.
Deployment readiness is relevant only when delivery includes operational changes.

seo_manager.reason: SEO strategy must preserve explicit business scope and evidence.

seo_specialist.reason: SEO analysis must preserve evidence, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
SEO verification uses the testing playbook when implementation is in scope.
